New York: De Beers London reopened its Madison Avenue flagship, its first redesign outside Paris.

The Upper East Side boutique, open since 2016, now spans a reimagined 2,156 sq. ft. Gold-toned walls echo Namibian sand dunes; oak floors draw on Botswanan basket weaving. De Beers London calls itself a home of diamonds since 1888.
